finding: The authenticated evidence manifest validated declared raw-output SHA-256 values but did not read the retained files and recompute those digests, so a caller could provide internally consistent declarations that were not bound to retained bytes.

covered_cases: symlink alias resolving to the primary file

evidence_strength: committed implementation with isolated deterministic runtime verification

source_status.runtime_result: directly observed in isolated Node execution

uncertainty: The complete repository integration suite was not executed in an authenticated checkout.
The wrapper has not yet processed real authenticated GitHub workflow outputs.
Distinct retained files do not alone prove operational independence of the clients that produced them.
falsification_route: Run the committed test in a clean checkout.
Attempt a manifest write with a modified retained file after its digest is declared; the write must fail with raw_output_digest_mismatch.
Point both methods through distinct symlink paths to the same inode; the write must fail with independent_raw_output_reuses_primary_file.
Execute both authenticated enumeration clients and verify the bound writer succeeds only with both retained files present and byte-accurate.
